meta.name: create-skill-autoresearch
meta.description: Factory skill that creates production-grade, benchmarked, autonomously improved, and verified agent skills. Orchestrates a 5-phase pipeline: interview the user to discover purpose and gold standards, research domain materials with parallel subagents, draft the skill with a design-first approach, invoke autoresearch to iterate against gold-standard-driven LLM-as-judge evaluation, and verify quality through multi-agent consensus with a devil's advocate. Use when building a new skill, creating a skill from existing materials, or upgrading a skill to production quality with benchmarking and autonomous improvement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建、测试并优化生产级 agent 技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从零构建或升级一个高质量、可自主迭代的 agent 技能。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create, test, and optimize production-grade agent skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build or upgrade a high-quality, autonomously improving agent skill from scratch.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成5个阶段来创建技能：先通过提问了解你的需求，然后研究相关资料，接着设计并编写技能文件，再自动测试和改进，最后让多个AI角色验证质量。最终输出一个可直接使用的技能文件。
howto.when: 当你想创建一个新的AI技能，或者想改进已有的技能时，可以启动这个技能。它会主动询问你一系列问题来收集信息。

say.text: 帮我创建一个能自动整理笔记的技能。
say.note: Claude 会开始面试流程，询问技能目的、示例等。

say.text: 升级我现有的代码审查技能，让它更可靠。
say.note: Claude 会加载现有技能，研究并改进它。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through 5 phases to create a skill: interview to understand needs, research domain materials, draft the skill, auto-improve via testing, and verify quality with multiple AI agents. Outputs a ready-to-use skill file.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you want to create a new AI skill or upgrade an existing one. Claude will ask structured questions to gather requirements.

say_en.text: Create a skill that automatically organizes my notes.
say_en.note: Claude starts the interview process to gather details.

say_en.text: Upgrade my existing code review skill to be more reliable.
say_en.note: Claude loads the existing skill, researches, and improves it.
